$comment: This deployment's agent config. deploy.sh uploads it to the config bucket, where the agent reads it once at startup — so a change needs ./deploy.sh --config-only --restart. Secrets never go here: the Gemini keys come from Secret Manager via GEMINI_API_KEYS_SECRET, and gemini.api_keys is a shape contract that must stay empty. query_param_key is omitted deliberately; with none set, the ?key= request overrides are disabled outright. See the Configuration section of README.md.

mcp._comment: Local-development default only, and never the value that ships: a deployed instance gets MCP_SERVER_URL from Terraform, pointing at your CDC instance, and the env var wins over this. The port here matches the `gcloud run services proxy ... --port=8082` that RUNNING.md uses, so a laptop run finds the tunnel without further configuration.

knowledge_base._comment: Disabled by default. To enable RAG: (1) provision a Gemini File Search corpus at aistudio.google.com, (2) upload your reference documents to it, (3) paste the corpus ID into gemini.filestores[] above, (4) set enabled to true.

template_vars._comment: Substituted into {{instance.*}} placeholders in prompts/. Set these to your own deployment's identity.
template_vars.name: Example Data Commons
